elevation_m_min.limitation: Lowest sampled pixel in the cell; noise-sensitive

slope_deg_mean.limitation: Slope of the surface model; building edges inflate it

rel_elev_m_mean.limitation: Cell elevation minus ~1 km neighbourhood mean; negative = lower than surroundings. A low-lying proxy, not drainage.

depression_depth_m_max.limitation: Depth of the deepest closed depression in the cell after filling a SURFACE model; buildings create spurious pits and real drains/culverts are invisible

flow_acc_log10_m2_max.limitation: Largest D8 upslope area in the cell on a surface model; shows where surface water would concentrate, ignores storm drains

n_samples.limitation: DEM pixels sampled in the cell
